system: General census of population, housing, agriculture and livestock 2024
rule: ruled: a donor contribution to the 2024 census is a grant, and the census is held as taken, with preliminary results, in BDI-001 to BDI-004 (4c 2026-11-06)
ruled: a donor grant naming support to the 2019 census does not state the census was taken; the record gives a 2024 commitment only (4c 2026-11-06)
ruled: restates the 2017 census held as MOZ-003, MOZ-005 and MOZ-007, from a donor grant line (4c 2026-11-06)
ruled: a foundation grant to collect pre-census data is a donor's intention, and names no work by or for the government (4c 2026-11-06)
